edge_cases: full grouped-query attention: H_Q=2 query heads share H_KV=1 KV head (GROUP_SIZE=2); per head QK^T (HMX) -> scale+softmax (HVX) -> A.V (HMX)

GQA mechanism: the shared KV head's HMX weight croutons -- K (QK^T) and V (A.V) -- are packed into VTCM ONCE and left resident, reused across both query heads without re-packing; only the query/probs activation side is re-packed per head
K stored [H_KV,S,D] row-major (row j IS key vector j) -> QK^T needs only swapped crouton tile indices, no transpose buffer
A.V reduction axis is the key axis S; V is a generic B[K,N] operand (no transpose)
softmax over the KEY axis; scale applied as >>4 on the 0x40-requant field
softmax probs are a normalized row (sum ~255) so the A.V accumulator stays < 2048 -> requant field exact
query head 1 row 0 all-zeros -> uniform softmax edge case
both HMX matmuls per head: 2x2 grid of 32x32 crouton tiles, 2-tile reduction, one mxclracc per output tile
crouton pack/unpack staged in cacheable DDR + bulk 128B HVX vector copies to/from VTCM (scalar VTCM access ~48 cyc)
LCG fill draws from bits >>13 (not the raw low 3 bits) so head0 and head1's Q data don't alias -- the raw low bits repeat with a period dividing S*D=4096 and would mask a wrong-head-grouping bug
wrong-grouping near-miss (forgets to advance the query pointer per head -- head1 reads head0's Q) must fail, specifically on head1's output range (first_bad=4096)
input ranges chosen so every requant field < 2048 (12-bit field exact, whole block bit-exact)
name: i8_gqa_attention_block

params.exp_lut: 256 uint8 entries (runtime), fixed-point exp, index 255 = exp(0)
params.scale: arithmetic >>4 on the 0x40-requant field (net ~1/15, in the 1/sqrt(D) regime)

signal: grouped-query attention block (matmul + softmax, shared-KV-head weight reuse)
